description: MP1584EN step-down (buck) module, D-SUN board, adjustable 3.3-12V version (trimmer on board)

ports.label: OUT+ / OUT-
ports.note: tensão definida pelo trimmer da placa (variante ajustável, anunciada para 3,3–12 V); ajuste ANTES de ligar qualquer carga

specs.chip: Monolithic Power Systems MP1584, 3 A 1.5 MHz 28 V step-down converter, internal high-side MOSFET, current mode control

output-voltage.note: set by the on-board trimmer; the chip regulates against an internal 0.8 V reference; the board variant bought is the adjustable one, advertised for the 3.3 to 12 V range

features: enable / shutdown pin on the chip

working-temperature.note: figure published by the module seller; the MP1584 chip itself is specified for -40 to 85 C junction

specs.note: adjust the output with the trimmer before connecting any load: the board leaves the factory at an arbitrary setting
